$comment: The theme layer's declarations: one entry per export of theme-layer.css.ts, checked by `pnpm ui:check` (ui-tools/theme-layer.mjs, rule L). Crops are the owner's before/after images (kept outside the repository), by set and item; baselines are committed entries that show the look.

entries.name: dialog-title-focus-target
entries.changes: No focus line on the title that receives the dialog's initial focus (the inspector's and the gate report's); the title's type is the design system's DialogTitle variant="code".
entries.reason: pxsig's focus model: the title is focused by script (tabIndex -1, initialFocus) as the dialog's starting point, so the dialog's keys work at once. It is not a control.
entries.a11y: The title is not in the tab order and not operable, so WCAG 2.4.7 asks no indicator of it; the first Tab moves to a control, which draws the design system's focus line. Screen readers are unaffected: the title names the dialog and focus lands on it.

entries.name: report-description-size
entries.changes: The gate report's description at fontSize.sm (14px) instead of the design system's 13px; colour, line and measure unchanged.
entries.reason: Matches the report body's own running text (the check line and notes are pxsig's 14px text).

entries.name: story-card

target.component: story card (the dashboard's own button or div, not a contract component)

entries.changes: The story card: 1px border, radius.lg, surface, accent border on hover; on keyboard focus the border in the focus colour with a 3px halo at 50% of it, and a transparent 1px outline that only forced-colors mode paints. Its status edges (overview.css.ts) are line.emphasis wide.
entries.reason: An exception to decision 35 (every focus line is the shared focus line): the halo is pxsig's own look on its own card. The outline keeps a focused card visible in forced-colors mode, where the halo and border colour are dropped.
entries.noBaseline: No screen focuses a card: the baselines show the card at rest, the crop N8 its focus.
entries.a11y: The 3:1 indicator is the 1px border in the focus colour; the halo is decoration. Forced-colors mode paints the outline.

entries.name: more-menu-current
entries.changes: The More menu's current section in semibold and the accent colour, beside the design system's medium weight and 2px primary start edge.
entries.reason: pxsig's own look for the current section, kept by the owner as it was.
entries.noBaseline: No screen opens More while the current section is in it (the More screen is on Overview, which stays in the bar); the crop L4 shows it at 800px on Runs.
entries.a11y: The weight and colour add to the design system's marker, which stays; aria-current marks the item for assistive technology.

entries.name: progress-one-line
entries.changes: A progress bar in a flex row takes the free width, its label on one line, cut with an ellipsis; no change to the look at the fixtures' widths.
entries.reason: The progress rows (review session, React analysis) keep one line at every width, kept by the owner as it was.
entries.noCrop: Kept as it was with no look change at any fixture width, so no before/after crop was made; the baselines show it.
entries.a11y: The label is cut visually only; the progress bar's accessible name is the whole label.
